text:
maria: Heads up — sampleapp's embed -> rerank path is returning 1536-d vectors but our JS SDK and the reranker expect 1024. Anyone else hitting this?

aj: Oof. Haven't seen that one today. Which model id and SDK version?

maria: model: redwood/m-embed-v1 (catalog page lists 1024). SDK: @redwood/js 0.9.2 from sampleapp.

sam: Can you paste the request/response snippet?

maria: ```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "redwood/m-embed-v1", "input": "..." }

200 OK
{ "data": [{ "embedding": [0.012, ..., (1536 floats) ...] }] }
```

chloe: We're also seeing a bunch of auth refresh retries in staging — token refresh races cause 401->refresh->retry->401 loop with SDK 0.9.2 :cry: 

devx-bot: Incident created: INF-4123 (auth retry loop observed in embed pipeline) :bell:

aj: Probable cause: native binding mismatch / model variant returning full precision dims, and node binding isn't validating shape. Python bindings trim/normalize in one place, node leaves raw length.

maria: Quick local workaround was `embeddings[0].slice(0,1024)` before passing to rerank. Not great for quality.

sam: We should add a sanity check in the SDK/batching helper to validate dim and raise a clear error (or offer explicit pad/trim strategies). Open an issue + PR.

chloe: I'll create the issue and include the auth-retry screenshots. Also adding a test for token refresh backoff.

maria: repro/sampleapp link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/compare/embedding-dim-repro

aj: For batching helper idea: group by vector length and fail fast for mixed-length batches. Maybe expose a config: { padStrategy: 'error'|'pad'|'trim' }

sam: agree. If pad/trim is allowed it should be opt-in and logged as a warning. Silent padding will bite evals.

chloe: note for product: docs should call out model dimension compatibility and SDK behavior in onboarding guide.

maria: THANKS everyone :raised_hands: I'll link the repro to INF-4123. Put follow-ups in sprint.

aj: assigning to @chloe and @sam to triage. Thanks.
